$description: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-02 (de-branding + registry-reconciliation pass). Retired the standalone `ibm-carbon-org-chart`/`org-chart-extended` pillar this file fed — that pillar name embedded a competing product's brand name (IBM Carbon) directly into shipped CSS custom-property names (--ps-ibm-carbon-org-chart-warm-gray-20/70), which is exactly what the design system's de-branding pass exists to remove. The one real value here (IBM Carbon Warm Gray — a generic, non-tenant primitive, legitimate under design-tokens.md rule 6) is re-homed into the paper.*.org-chart family it always conceptually belonged with (the same family that already owns canvas-width, edge-stroke-width, node geometry, and the other role colors). No longer read by bin/generate-tokens-export.py; kept here (not deleted) as the historical record per this repo's own supersession convention. Original description, for the record: "Woodfine org-chart extended colour tokens — IBM Carbon extension. IBM Carbon Warm Gray added to the Woodfine corporate palette. Tinted treatment: -70 border, -20 background fill. Additive-only — existing Material Design and Tailwind primitives in the core palette are unchanged. Companion CSS: components/nodes.css (token-warm-gray). Semantic roles: tokens/charts/token-chart-semantic.yaml. Master co-sign: command@claude-code 2026-06-01."

ibm-carbon-org-chart.$description: IBM Carbon primitive colour values consumed by Woodfine org-chart token classes

20.$description: IBM Carbon Warm Gray 20 — background fill for token-warm-gray nodes. SUPERSEDED BY paper.primitive.color.org-chart-role-warm-gray-bg.

70.$description: IBM Carbon Warm Gray 70 — border colour for token-warm-gray nodes. SUPERSEDED BY paper.primitive.color.org-chart-role-warm-gray-border.

org-chart-extended.$description: Semantic org-chart token entries for the IBM Carbon colour extension. Each entry maps a CSS class name to its background and border primitives. Node geometry (210x110px, 10px padding, solid border, z-index 4) is defined in components/nodes.css — see paper.primitive.org-chart.node-* / paper.primitive.org-chart.node-pill-radius for the re-homed geometry primitives.

background.$description: Warm Gray tinted node background — use for holding companies and passive holding entities above the main management layer. SUPERSEDED BY paper.semantic.org-chart.role-warm-gray-bg.

border.$description: Warm Gray tinted node border. SUPERSEDED BY paper.semantic.org-chart.role-warm-gray-border.
